title: Duplicate argument in _emit_audit_event() call
description: v2_integration.py line 309 called _emit_audit_event() with 'result' as both positional and keyword argument, causing TypeError.
remediation: Changed 'result=result.to_dict()' to 'data=result.to_dict()' to avoid keyword conflict.

title: tenant_id=None not rejected at plan creation
description: PluginDevelopmentPlan accepts tenant_id=None without raising ValueError in __post_init__. Violates fail-closed security gate.
root_cause: Missing explicit None check before fallback to current_tenant()
remediation: Add explicit validation in __post_init__: if self.tenant_id is None: raise ValueError('Invalid tenant_id: None not allowed'). Prioritize validation over fallback.
test_evidence: test_3_2_tenant_id_none_rejected fails (expects ValueError, gets None accepted)
mitigation: Deploy with tenant_id validation enabled; operator must always provide explicit tenant_id

title: plugin_id path traversal not validated
description: PluginDevelopmentPlan accepts malicious plugin_id values like '../../../etc/passwd' without validation.
root_cause: No regex validation on plugin_id field
remediation: Add validation in __post_init__: assert re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+$', self.plugin_id), 'plugin_id contains invalid characters'. Reject '..' and path traversal patterns.
test_evidence: test_3_4_scaffold_directory_traversal fails (expects ValueError/AssertionError, gets plan accepted)
mitigation: Deploy with plugin_id whitelist check; CI/CD validates plugin_id before merge

title: AuditChainWriter.write() method not implemented
description: Audit infrastructure instantiates AuditChainWriter but its write() method does not exist, causing AttributeError in all workflow runs.
root_cause: AuditChainWriter is a stub/mock without write() method implementation
remediation: Implement write(event: dict) -> None method in AuditChainWriter to persist events to audit chain. Must support hash-chaining per ADR-0232.
test_evidence: Audit events not emitted; warnings show 'AuditChainWriter' object has no attribute 'write' in all development workflows
mitigation: Audit infrastructure optional (degrades gracefully); development proceeds with warnings
fix_timeline: Before Phase 4 release (audit trail required for compliance)

title: PackageMetadata missing tenant_id attribute
description: PackageMetadata object used in build step does not have tenant_id attribute, causing build to fail in tenant-scoped environments.
root_cause: PackageMetadata model not updated to support tenant_id field required by v2_integration tenant-scoping
remediation: Add tenant_id: str field to PackageMetadata dataclass. Update PackageBuilder to populate it from PluginDevelopmentPlan.tenant_id during build phase.
test_evidence: test_7_1_scaffold_preserved_on_build_failure fails on build: 'PackageMetadata' object has no attribute 'tenant_id'
mitigation: Deploy with single-tenant builds only; multi-tenant support gated on this fix
fix_timeline: Before Phase 4 release (tenant-scoping is load-bearing per ADR-0262)
